description: Unit 603, sixth floor of The Meridian. A concrete studio with a drop ceiling, a water stain spreading in one corner, and bare cable hookups. The single window faces the airshaft and another wall close enough to touch. Old picture hooks on the walls.

window.description: A plain sash window, painted shut some years ago, with a view of the block opposite.
window.name: the window
